map.跨午夜怎么录？: How do I enter a stage after midnight?
map.直接选择第2天并填 00:15，无需把后录的早时间猜成次日；工具按天与时间排序并: Choose Day 2 and enter 00:15; there is no guessing that an earlier clock time means the next day. The tool sorts by day and time and displays “Day N HH:MM”.
